request: Our goal for the next event is to INCREASE PLAYER PARTICIPATION. Look at the past events and player feedback, then recommend the next event format.
final_answer: The proposed event format, "Daily First Win Bonus," has been selected based on its high participation rate (61.99%) and positive player feedback. To improve the experience, the reward for the first win will be increased, and a skill-based matchmaking system will be implemented to ensure fair competition, especially for new players. These changes aim to boost motivation and participation while addressing concerns about fairness and reward value. The draft is now ready for human review.

draft.rationale: The 'Daily First Win Bonus' format (tested in E2) achieved the highest participation rate of 0.6199, significantly higher than E1's 0.0256. This format also received positive feedback from players, with many expressing that it motivates them to play daily. However, there were complaints about new players struggling to win and the reward being too small. To address these issues, we can adjust the reward to be more substantial and improve matchmaking to ensure fair competition for new players.
changes: Increase the reward for the first win to make it more valuable for players.
Implement a skill-based matchmaking system to ensure fair competition for new players.
Consider increasing the frequency of rewards or adjusting the reward amount to maintain player motivation.

verified_evidence.text_zh: 打了一晚上一把都没胡，首胜奖励跟我没关系
verified_evidence.text_en: Played all evening without winning a single hand. The first-win reward has nothing to do with me.

verified_evidence.text_zh: 新手怎么跟老手打啊，能不能按水平匹配
verified_evidence.text_en: How are newbies supposed to beat veterans? Can matchmaking go by skill level?

verified_evidence.text_zh: 2000金币打一局低倍场就没了，太少
verified_evidence.text_en: 2,000 coins are gone after one low-stakes match. Too little.

verified_evidence.text_zh: 一天只能领一次，胡了第一把就没动力继续打了
verified_evidence.text_en: Only once a day. After the first win there's no reason to keep playing.

verified_evidence.text_zh: 晚上八点排队要等一分钟
verified_evidence.text_en: At 8 pm the queue takes a whole minute.

verified_evidence.text_zh: 每天上来胡一把领奖励，挺有动力的
verified_evidence.text_en: Log in, win one hand, get the reward. Gives me a reason to play every day.

verified_evidence.text_zh: 每天领2000金币，够我多打好几局
verified_evidence.text_en: 2,000 free coins every day means I can play a few more matches.

verified_evidence.text_zh: 比签到有意思，至少要真的打牌
verified_evidence.text_en: More interesting than a check-in. At least you actually have to play.

events.name: Weekend Coin Bundle
events.how_it_works: A special coin bundle sold only during the event: 60,000 coins for $4.99, about twice the coins of the regular $4.99 shop pack. Limit one per player per day. Regular shop packs are unchanged. Shown as a pop-up at login and in the shop.

events.name: Daily First Win Bonus
events.how_it_works: The first hand a player wins each day gives 2,000 bonus coins. One reward per day.
